functions.title: Search CRM accounts
functions.description: Search CRM accounts visible to the delegated user and return bounded public business metadata.

completeness.notes: The Core handler returns at most eight accounts and does not provide a total.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args: { query?: string }): Promise<AccountSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search CRM contacts
functions.description: Search contacts visible to the current user in the current workspace.

completeness.notes: The Core handler caps contacts at eight rows and does not query a total.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args: { query?: string; crmAccountId?: string }): Promise<ContactSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search CRM leads
functions.description: Search leads visible to the delegated user and return only bounded business fields; lead name, email, and phone are excluded.

completeness.notes: Scoped total is known; rows are capped at twenty and no cursor is implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args: { query?: string; status?: 'New' | 'Contacted' | 'Qualified' | 'Disqualified' | 'Converted'; organizationId?: string }): Promise<LeadSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search CRM deals
functions.description: Search deals visible to the current user in the current workspace.

completeness.notes: The Core handler returns a scoped total and caps rows at twenty; nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args: { query?: string; stage?: string; personName?: string; pipelineName?: string }): Promise<DealSearchResult>;

functions.title: Get deal history
functions.description: Read the bounded history projection for one visible deal.

completeness.notes: Recent history is intentionally partial and bounded; it is not an audit-log replacement.

functions.declaration: declare function history(args: { deal_id?: string; deal_title?: string }): Promise<DealHistoryResult>;

functions.title: Summarize sales pipeline
functions.description: Return the Core-computed pipeline aggregate for the current workspace.

completeness.notes: The Core handler computes a complete scoped aggregate and excludes Closed Lost.

functions.title: List sales pipelines
functions.description: List sales pipelines visible to the current user with stage names and visible open-deal counts.

completeness.notes: total is the number of pipelines visible in scope; rows are capped at twenty and nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.title: Check pipeline health
functions.description: Report visible open-deal pipeline health: counts of stale, stuck and soon-to-close deals with the top 10 of each. Deal values and contact names are excluded; the total value is null when masked.

completeness.notes: Summary counts cover every visible open deal; each list is capped at the 10 most urgent entries and partial is true when a list was truncated.

functions.title: Search CRM notes
functions.description: Search CRM notes visible to the current user and return a truncated preview; other users' personal notes, tags and full content are excluded.

completeness.notes: The Core handler returns a scoped total (other users' personal notes excluded) and caps rows at twenty; nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; dealId?: string; contactId?: string; activityId?: string; crmAccountId?: string }): Promise<NoteSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search CRM products
functions.description: Search the product catalog visible to the current user; price is null when the user lacks sensitive-financial access. Packages, assets and pricing internals are excluded.

completeness.notes: The Core handler returns a scoped total and caps rows at twenty; nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string }): Promise<ProductSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search sales contracts
functions.description: Search sales contracts visible to the current user by start month or expiry window; contract value and notes are excluded.

completeness.notes: The Core handler returns a scoped total and caps rows at twenty; nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { month?: string; expiringSoon?: boolean }): Promise<ContractSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search CRM quotes
functions.description: Search quotes visible to the current user by status, deal or contact; amount, notes and contact details are excluded.

completeness.notes: The Core handler returns a scoped total and caps rows at twenty; nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { status?: 'Draft' | 'Sent' | 'Approved' | 'Rejected'; dealId?: string; contactId?: string }): Promise<QuoteSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search team members
functions.description: Search team members inside the current user's org-chart scope and return only id, display name and role; email, phone and credentials are excluded.

completeness.notes: total is the number of in-scope members matching the query; rows are sorted by name, capped at twenty and nextCursor is not implemented.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string }): Promise<TeamSearchResult>;

functions.title: Search care tickets
functions.description: List after-sales customer-care tickets (Customer Care console) visible to the delegated user, with category, account id, status, priority and SLA breach flag. Ticket details are never returned.

completeness.notes: Count is exact within the authorized scope; rows are bounded to twenty ordered by SLA due date.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { status?: 'open' | 'breach' | 'done'; category?: string; accountId?: string; limit?: number }): Promise<CareTicketSearchResult>;

functions.title: Read last meeting
functions.description: Read metadata and a short summary of the most recent meeting (or one meeting by id) visible to the delegated user. Transcript, analysis, audio and contact email are never returned.

completeness.notes: Single record; an out-of-scope meeting id is reported as not found.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { meetingId?: string }): Promise<LastMeetingResult>;

functions.title: Search activities
functions.description: Search bounded activities visible to the delegated user, optionally within a date range and sorted by date.

completeness.notes: At most twenty scoped activities are returned; the query matches titles only and activity notes are neither searched nor included.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { query?: string; type?: string; dealId?: string; contactId?: string; from?: string; to?: string; sort?: 'asc' | 'desc' }): Promise<ActivitySearchResult>;
